evidence.quote: Today I will focus on the third aspect of this effort--reforms intended to strengthen financial market infrastructures.
Increased central clearing and margins for noncleared derivatives are foundational elements of the program.
The Federal Reserve and six other agencies are responsible for establishing margin requirements for derivatives that are not cleared through a CCP.
